contract.actor: the existing single retained native video codec thread and capacity-one request channel
contract.input: shallow-cloned canonical IMAGE plus closed ten-bit selection, reduced frame rate, checked H.264 sequence limits, caller stream, scratch, and cancellation
contract.native_lifetime: the ten-bit H.264 MP4 session, AVIO output, suite borrow, and every FFmpeg pointer remain on and drop on the actor thread
contract.portable_output: one exact-length contiguous rank-one CPU U8 Tensor plus dimensions, reduced frame rate, frame count, SHA-256, ten-bit YUV420P10LE identity, and no alpha

test_cases: LTXV preprocessing, VP9 alpha, AV1, eight-bit H.264, and ten-bit H.264 requests execute serially on one non-caller actor thread
the ten-bit H.264 request preserves IMAGE storage identity, reduced rate, limits, stream, scratch, cancellation, and closed bit-depth selection
the returned H.264 Tensor is Send plus Sync, CPU U8 contiguous, exact length, content-digest bound, ten-bit YUV420P10LE, and non-alpha
scratch is zero before the successful response while backend resident bytes remain until Tensor drop
the existing eight-bit component-backing adapter rejects a contradictory ten-bit actor projection
